title: Normalized geometric model without coefficient or limit comparisons
statement: Let l be prime, X and S noetherian schemes, f:X→S, m:X≅P¹_S with m.hom followed by the projection equal to f, and l invertible on S. Put E = ULift Q_l. Given normalized Chern data cS,cX and Twisting data tS,tX for their actual root lines [def-sp-tower-class-chern, def-sp-tower-class-twisting], there exist a coefficient tower Base b [def-sp-tower-shriek-data] and a Model g [def-sfb-diagonal-trace-models] for f with these Chern/twist data and with g.model=m. No scalar restrictions, coefficient cones, derived-limit comparisons, splitting or trace are asserted.

source.place: paragraph (1), geometric model and line twisting before formation of the splitting

proof.text: Choose b and geometry g with their normalized ordinary coefficient-unit comparison q and ordinary tensor comparison k. Pull back the normalized Chern root line using q, k and invertibility of l to obtain p.

Specialize k to the base root line, then tensor in the second variable with p.iso. The universal sheaf tensor property gives the natural isomorphism tensorRight(p.iso). Its pure-section formula, k.normalization, and sectionAdjoint_postcomp prove the PositivePullback normalization. Transport through the two Twisting.forward equalities; every step here is proved in Lean.

Localize the positive comparison. Both derived twist functors are equivalences, so the mate is invertible by the general equivalence-mate theorem. Expand homEquiv_unit and mateEquiv_apply to identify its component exactly with projection. Use m and hm for model and over_eq, and assemble all Model fields. No local-freeness or splitting theorem is used for this final step.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_diagonalTraceGeometricModel (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian S]
    (f : X ⟶ S) (m : X ≅ ProjectiveLine S)
    (hm : m.hom ≫ (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S) = f)
    (hS : IsUnit (l : Γ(S, ⊤)))
    (cS : Chern l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) S)
    (cX : Chern l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) X)
    (nS : cS.Normalized l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)))
    (nX : cX.Normalized l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)))
    (tS : Twisting l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) cS)
    (tX : Twisting l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) cX) :
    ∃ b : SpTowerShriek.Base l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)),
      ∃ g : Model l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) b S X f cS cX tS tX,
        g.model = m
